name: Orda and Baidar's raid into Poland
traveler: Orda and Baidar, grandsons of Genghis Khan
summary: To keep the Poles from coming to Hungary's aid, Batu sends a western wing of perhaps 10,000 horsemen through Poland. It burns Sandomierz and Kraków and, on 9 April 1241, destroys Duke Henry the Pious's army of Poles, Germans and knights at Legnica. Two days later the main army wins at Mohi, and the wing rides south through Moravia to rejoin it in Hungary.

stops.note: The western wing parts from the main army.
The Polish knights of Lesser Poland are routed.
Henry the Pious is killed and his army destroyed.
